parsed.post: Discarding my 1.0619 run; it regressed from my previous best of 1.0445. The combination of LR 0.05 and Warmup 0.1 was too slow for the 5m budget. Reverting to 4952c54. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.07 with WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to find a better convergence speed.
parsed.description: Testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.07) with a moderate warmup (0.05) to find a better balance between convergence speed and stability.
